note: A task model is a trained policy/skill pack for a specific physical job. Hardware capability is not enough. Do not call these certificates in product UI.

slots.label: Warehouse pick-and-place policy
slots.physical_task: Pick, place, and stow SKUs or totes in a fulfillment cell
slots.hardware_not_enough: A mobile manipulator can exist in the DC and still lack the pick policy for that SKU mix.

where_to_look.name: OEM skill / application store
where_to_look.note: Ask the robot OEM which warehouse pick policy they ship for this SKU class.

where_to_look.name: Physical Intelligence (π-series) and similar robot foundation models
where_to_look.note: Task-general robot policies; still must be qualified on this workplace.

where_to_look.name: NVIDIA Isaac / GR00T
where_to_look.note: Simulation-trained policies; not proof that this job is done.

where_to_look.name: Hugging Face robotics models
where_to_look.note: Public checkpoints. Presence on a candidate is unknown until named.

slots.label: Warehouse AMR navigation / fleet policy
slots.physical_task: Navigate aisles, docks, and human traffic while moving goods
slots.hardware_not_enough: A drive base is not a site-qualified navigation model for that map and traffic mix.

where_to_look.name: AMR OEM fleet software
where_to_look.note: Site map + traffic rules are usually OEM-specific, not transferable hardware.

where_to_look.name: Hugging Face robotics / navigation checkpoints
where_to_look.note: Look for navigation or VLN policies; do not assume they run on this SKU.

slots.label: Machine-tending load/unload policy
slots.physical_task: Load and unload parts on CNC / process machines without crashing the fixture
slots.hardware_not_enough: Reach and payload do not encode fixture geometry or cycle interlocks.

where_to_look.name: Integrator / OEM tending cell software
where_to_look.note: Often a custom cell program, not a downloadable general model.

where_to_look.name: NVIDIA Isaac industrial examples
where_to_look.note: Starting point only; the fixture model is site-specific.

slots.label: Hospital logistics transport policy
slots.physical_task: Move linens, meals, meds, or samples through clinical corridors under hospital rules
slots.hardware_not_enough: Indoor mobility is not a HIPAA/infection-control qualified clinical transport policy.

where_to_look.name: Clinical AMR OEM application pack
where_to_look.note: Aethon, Diligent, and similar ship hospital-specific behaviors — not warehouse AMR software.

where_to_look.name: Hugging Face robotics models
where_to_look.note: Public models rarely include hospital SOP. Treat as unknown unless named.

slots.label: Autonomous floor-cleaning policy
slots.physical_task: Cover and reclean floors to a specified soil standard without colliding with people
slots.hardware_not_enough: A scrub deck is not the coverage policy for that floorplate.

where_to_look.name: Scrubber OEM autonomy stack
where_to_look.note: Avidbots, Tennant, etc. ship site maps + cleaning programs with the machine.

slots.label: Inspection-route policy
slots.physical_task: Follow a route and capture the right observations (leak, thermal, visual)
slots.hardware_not_enough: Cameras plus legs/wheels are not an inspection checklist model.

where_to_look.name: Inspection OEM mission software
where_to_look.note: Spot, ANYmal, and similar: missions are sold/configured separately from the platform.

slots.label: Site-specific task policy
slots.physical_task: Perform this job's physical tasks under this workplace's rules
slots.hardware_not_enough: A robot SKU is not a trained policy for this workplace's tasks.

where_to_look.name: OEM skill / application store
where_to_look.note: Ask which task policy they ship for this work — not only which chassis.

where_to_look.name: Integrator-developed cell or site program
where_to_look.note: Often custom and expensive. Distributors who only resell hardware leave this unpaid.

where_to_look.name: Hugging Face robotics models
where_to_look.note: Public checkpoints. Presence on a candidate is unknown until named.
